it did not come from this file.

============================================================
SHORT DESCRIPTION  (80-char field -- this is 77)
============================================================

Storm sewer sizing, HGL, detention, BMPs and PE-ready reports inside Civil 3D.

============================================================
LONG DESCRIPTION  (4092 characters)
============================================================

HydroComplete reads your pipe networks and catchments straight out of the open drawing, runs the hydrology and hydraulics on published public-domain methods, and writes results back onto dedicated layers  -  with the equation behind every number shown line by line.

Built by a practising professional engineer for the routine sizing, checking and reporting work Civil 3D users do constantly  -  no re-keying geometry into a separate model. 52 commands on a HydroComplete ribbon tab, all available from the command line.

STORM SEWER HYDRAULICS
  HC_PIPES      Manning full-barrel capacity, normal depth and velocity for every pipe
  HC_CAPACITY   design Q vs full capacity, d/D and surcharge flags, optional labels
  HC_HGL        steady hydraulic grade line at design Q with HEC-22 junction and exit
                losses, plan labels and a 3D profile polyline
  HC_PROFILE    chainage profile of invert, crown and HGL
  HC_INLETS     HEC-22 grate-on-grade, sag and curb-opening inlet capacity
  HC_CULVERT    inlet and outlet control check
  HC_GVF        gradually varied flow profile, standard step
  HC_PUMP       pump station duty point against the system head curve
  HC_SIZE       diameter and slope sizing; HC_VALIDATE slope/capacity/velocity/cover review
  HC_NETWORK    topology and connectivity audit

HYDROLOGY
  HC_RATIONAL   Q = CiA from catchment geometry with composite runoff coefficients
  HC_SCS        SCS/NRCS curve number runoff
  HC_TC         TR-55 segmented time of concentration
  HC_UNIT_HYDRO, HC_HYDROGRAPH, HC_ROUTE_HYDRO  unit hydrographs, network routing
  HC_ATLAS14    live NOAA Atlas 14 PFDS IDF by drawing geolocation, cached, with
                embedded city presets offline
  HC_LOSS       Green-Ampt, Horton or SCS CN incremental loss on a design storm
  HC_CONTINUOUS multi-year daily continuous simulation
  HC_DETENTION  Modified Puls routing with multi-stage outlets
  HC_PREPOST    pre- versus post-development comparison, HC_MULTIRP multi-return-period

WATER QUALITY, BMPs AND SEDIMENT
  HC_WQV, HC_BMP_SIZE, HC_WQ_TRAIN  water quality volume, BMP sizing, treatment trains
  HC_BIORETENTION, HC_WETLAND       practice-specific sizing
  HC_SEDIMENT, HC_SEDIMENT_BASIN    RUSLE/MUSLE loads and basin sizing
  HC_OPTIMIZE   least-cost BMP selection against a removal target
  HC_REVIEW     compliance check against state and local criteria

VISUAL MODEL BUILDER
  HC_DAG        drag-and-drop node editor wiring hydrology, hydraulics and water quality
                engines into one pipeline: 20 node types, templates, charts, HTML and SVG
                export, saved beside the drawing by HC_DAG_SAVE / HC_DAG_LOAD.
                Civil 3D 2025 and 2026 only.

REPORTS AND DATA EXCHANGE
  HC_REPORT     HTML report with KaTeX-typeset equations and step-by-step traces
  HC_REPORT_PDF sealable PDF export (Pro)
  HC_NETWORK_DIAGRAM, HC_WQ_DIAGRAM   HTML/SVG schematics for submittal packages
  HC_LANDXML, HC_LANDXML_IMPORT       LandXML 1.2 export and import, box and arch shapes
  HC_PROFILE_DXF, HC_COST, HC_SOIL (live USDA SSURGO), HC_BACKGROUND

METHODS

Rational  |  SCS/NRCS curve number and unit hydrograph  |  TR-55 and Kirpich Tc  |  IDF
i = a/(t+b)^c  |  Manning, circular, box and arch, full and partial flow  |  HEC-22 minor
losses and inlets  |  Modified Puls  |  Muskingum-Cunge  |  standard step GVF  |  RUSLE and
MUSLE. Every result carries a step trace of label, value, units and formula.

FREE AND PRO

Everything above runs in the free tier. Pro adds sealable PDF report export, activated
with HC_ACTIVATE using a token from hydrocomplete.com; HC_LICENSE shows the tier. The
plugin works offline  -  internet is used only for live Atlas 14 and SSURGO lookups and for
licence validation.

WHAT IT IS NOT

Not a replacement for a full hydraulic modelling suite. It targets routine storm sewer
sizing, HGL checks and defensible reporting, where the friction is transcription and
review. US customary units. Drawing-driven commands need Civil 3D pipe network and
catchment objects.

More at https://hydrocomplete.com/civil3d
